zh.title: 苏丹森纳尔州：青尼罗河战事外溢，实施夜间宵禁与货运限制
zh.summary: 11月21日森纳尔州发布2026年第6号紧急命令，城镇22:00至04:00禁止通行，货运车辆20:00至05:00禁止运行；背景为青尼罗河州武装推进及达马津周边局势恶化。
zh.region: 苏丹／森纳尔州与青尼罗河州
zh.body: 事实｜Radio Tamazuj于2026年11月21日报道，森纳尔州州长Al-Zubair Hassan Al-Sayed签发2026年第6号紧急命令，规定城镇22:00—04:00禁止人员流动，全州货运车辆20:00—05:00停止运行；持许可的医疗及紧急救援等人员获得例外。与此同时，RSF与SPLM-N结盟部队据地方消息在青尼罗河州Bau、Geissan推进，Taga和Madina 11据报失守，达马津居民开始撤离。有关控制范围属地方消息报道。分析｜州政府在战事抵近前限制夜间人员及物流活动，意在压缩武装渗透和非正规运输的行动空间，同时也显示地方政府预期冲突可能跨州扩散。另一种解释是政府通过预防性管制向公众和军方展示控制力，即使短期并无直接攻城行动。运营传导｜森纳尔州境内夜间干线货运窗口被实质压缩，跨州燃料、粮食、医疗物资和项目补给须调整车次及装卸时间；东森纳尔民间动员与军事协作可能增加检查站及车辆盘查。管理层应将夜间跨州运输暂停并核算白天运力缺口，确认货车是否享有行业例外，审查达马津方向人员驻留及撤离路线。后续指标｜①第6号命令实际执法及例外许可证发放；②Bau与Geissan控制权的独立核实；③达马津人口外流与道路通行变化；④森纳尔州检查站和货运延误。来源：https://www.radiotamazuj.org/en/news/article/sennar-imposes-night-curfew-as-blue-nile-fighting-intensifies

en.title: Sudan / Sennar: Night curfew and freight restrictions as Blue Nile fighting approaches
en.summary: Sennar authorities imposed a 22:00–04:00 urban curfew and a 20:00–05:00 freight-vehicle restriction on 21 November amid reported armed advances in neighbouring Blue Nile State.
en.region: Sudan / Sennar and Blue Nile states
en.body: Facts | Radio Tamazuj reported on 21 November 2026 that Sennar Governor Al-Zubair Hassan Al-Sayed issued Emergency Order No. 6 of 2026, prohibiting movement in towns from 22:00 to 04:00 and goods-vehicle operations across the state from 20:00 to 05:00. Permitted medical and emergency responders are exempt. Local sources separately reported advances by RSF and SPLM-N-aligned forces in Bau and Geissan, including reported control of Taga and Madina 11; residents in Damazin have begun leaving. Territorial claims remain attributed to those local sources. Assessment | The curfew is a pre-emptive attempt to constrain night movement and possible armed infiltration as fighting moves closer to Sennar. An alternative interpretation is that the measure is primarily intended to demonstrate government control before any direct offensive against the state. Business transmission | The order materially reduces the night freight window for fuel, food, medical supplies and project logistics. Mobilisation in East Sennar may also increase checkpoints and inspections. Operators should reschedule cross-state freight to daylight, quantify lost capacity, confirm any permit exemptions and reassess personnel presence and evacuation options toward Damazin. Indicators | (1) Enforcement and exemptions under Order No. 6; (2) independently corroborated control changes in Bau and Geissan; (3) displacement and road access around Damazin; (4) checkpoint delays and freight throughput in Sennar. Source: https://www.radiotamazuj.org/en/news/article/sennar-imposes-night-curfew-as-blue-nile-fighting-intensifies
